verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a Linux desktop distribution with a documented CLI and a plugin ecosystem, so an interactive reference for its programmable surfaces is a fair question. The evidence shows no interactive API reference or runnable examples, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404. The documented omarchy CLI manual is ordinary command documentation, not an interactive API explorer, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
